note: Illustration manifest. `status` is honest about what exists: `present` ships today, `planned` has a written prompt and a slot reserved. Each act gets an opener and each must-land moment a key illustration, per the art plan.

format.note: Source PNG and JPEG are converted by tools/optimise-art.py. The measured result for the current set is 24.33 MB of source art down to 3.13 MB of WebP at a 1600 px cap.

illustrations.title: Rain over the bamboo village
illustrations.alt: Green bamboo dwellings on wooden stilts above misty mountain ground after rain.
illustrations.note: Pale-green two-storey bamboo and wood houses; wooden stakes below the living floor.

illustrations.title: Forty-four percent
illustrations.alt: Hope Gu gathering above moon orchids beside an underground river.
illustrations.note: A clear, faintly blue river; moon orchids with jade stems and pearl-bright centres on the far bank.

illustrations.title: What the mountain keeps
illustrations.alt: A dark inheritance chamber lit from one carried source.
illustrations.note: Used for the Flower Wine cave and again for the deep inheritance.

illustrations.title: Eyes above the path
illustrations.alt: An immense underground stone forest with jade-eyed shapes watching from the pillars.
illustrations.note: Must read as enclosed: the vault overhead is the point.

illustrations.title: The winter crossing
illustrations.alt: A snowbound mountain crossing under heavy cloud.
illustrations.note: Also used for the glacier at chapter 198.

illustrations.title: An arrangement, not a friendship
illustrations.alt: Two figures on broken ground, neither looking at the other.
illustrations.note: Bai must appear with one arm before chapter 199 and restored after it.

illustrations.title: The Yellow Dragon River
illustrations.alt: A raft on a wide river, a burning mountain behind.
illustrations.note: The last image in the game and the hand-off to the sequel.

illustrations.title: Spring, then autumn
illustrations.alt: An interpretive illustration of the Spring Autumn Cicada.

illustrations.title: Seated
illustrations.alt: A figure cultivating by lamplight.

illustrations.title: The council
illustrations.alt: A clan council pavilion interior.

illustrations.title: Steps to the hall
illustrations.alt: Steps up to a clan hall.

illustrations.title: The beast-skin map
illustrations.alt: An interpretive map of Qing Mao Mountain.

illustrations.title: The curtain
illustrations.alt: A red storm over a mountain.

illustrations.title: The investigator
illustrations.alt: A figure with a notebook.

illustrations.title: Bai
illustrations.alt: A pale-robed figure.

illustrations.title: The Gu room
illustrations.alt: Shelves of containers in a clan Gu room.

illustrations.title: The last stand of the first life
illustrations.alt: A cornered figure at full power in a ruined hall.
illustrations.prompt: Act opener. Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Night, storm, one doorway, eight silhouettes that have not come through it. The cornered figure is calm. Cool blue-green key, one warm lantern. No gore.

illustrations.title: Act I · Awakening
illustrations.alt: The mountain at dawn from above the village.
illustrations.prompt: Act I opener. Spear bamboo straight and sharp-tipped, stilted houses, rain clearing. Wide, quiet, a little too large for the figure in it.

illustrations.title: Someone on the path behind you
illustrations.alt: A night path through bamboo with two sets of prints.
illustrations.prompt: Night, mist, a narrow path, prints in wet clay going one way. Tension without violence. Cool palette, no figures.

illustrations.title: After class
illustrations.alt: An academy gate at the end of a school day.
illustrations.prompt: Late afternoon, students leaving, one pair standing slightly apart. Warm low light. The composition should make the waiting figure the calm one.

illustrations.title: Act II · Inheritance
illustrations.alt: An inheritance passage descending out of daylight.
illustrations.prompt: Act II opener. A sloping stone passage, a round boulder, light behind and darkness ahead.

illustrations.title: The year-end duel
illustrations.alt: Two youths across an examination arena with a crowd behind.
illustrations.prompt: Layered wards around one figure, nothing around the other. Daylight, dust, a watching crowd. Readable as a test, not a war.

illustrations.title: Act III · Assets and the wolf tide
illustrations.alt: A tavern's upper floor over a village street.
illustrations.prompt: Act III opener. Commerce and weather. Two-storey tavern, lanterns, a sky that is about to turn.

illustrations.title: A position that does not hold
illustrations.alt: A defended forest position seen from a ridge above.
illustrations.prompt: From above and far away, deliberately. The viewer is on the ridge, not in the line. Storm light, lightning in the undergrowth.

illustrations.title: Act IV · The mountain falls
illustrations.alt: A vast chamber beneath a clan's foundations.
illustrations.prompt: Act IV opener. Scale first: the room must feel built for something other than people.

illustrations.title: A theory that is wrong
illustrations.alt: A council hall with a notebook open on a table.
illustrations.prompt: Quiet, institutional, tense. The notebook is the subject of the picture.

illustrations.title: Rain on the upper floor
illustrations.alt: A small bamboo room with an open window and rain outside.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. The first thing the player sees after the prologue. Intimate, poor, specific: stakes below the floor, a thin blanket, a broken latch.

illustrations.title: Inside the purple-gold shell
illustrations.alt: A travelling market stall of sealed gambling stones.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Road-worn finery, rings, lamplight on sealed shells. Sell uncertainty in the composition.

illustrations.title: Rank one, middle stage
illustrations.alt: A seated figure at night as something settles.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. A ritual, not a pop-up. Stillness, one light source, no spectacle.

illustrations.title: The question beneath the question
illustrations.alt: A council pavilion interior with one youth standing.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Formal, grieving, out of evidence. The room should be larger than the matter.

illustrations.title: Knowledge carried in bamboo
illustrations.alt: A hunter's camp with a beast-skin map spread out.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Working notes, not treasure. Two bowls, a cooking fire, a portrait on the wall.

illustrations.title: What strength is for
illustrations.alt: A round boulder in a sloping stone passage.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Physical problem, physical answer. Light from behind, darkness ahead.

illustrations.title: Red steel, quietly
illustrations.alt: A lamplit back room with one seated figure.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Secrecy as composition: no witnesses in frame, and nowhere in frame to hide one.

illustrations.title: Inside the boar king
illustrations.alt: A snowfield after a beast crossing.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Aftermath only. Tracks, equipment, snow filling in. Nothing anatomical.

illustrations.title: The property changes hands
illustrations.alt: An affairs hall table with ledgers and a seal.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. The political squeeze rendered as paperwork. Make the documents the protagonist.

illustrations.title: Nine leaves and a buyer
illustrations.alt: Terraced beds of pale vitality grass at dusk.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. The most reliable income in the game, and the only healing. Quiet, cultivated, valuable.

illustrations.title: Staff, stock and troublemakers
illustrations.alt: The lower floor of a two-storey tavern, full.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Warm, crowded, working. A very large man on the door.

illustrations.title: Four Flavours
illustrations.alt: A refinement bench with two worms and a wine jar.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Expense made visible. The materials cost more than the room.

illustrations.title: Someone who recognises him
illustrations.alt: A rain-soaked forest path past a ridge.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Her relief is the whole picture, and she must be a person in it. No violence, no aftermath, nothing implied in frame.

illustrations.title: White silver
illustrations.alt: A breakthrough at night in deep forest.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. A full ritual. Cold light, no triumph in the staging.

illustrations.title: Under the clan
illustrations.alt: An enormous chamber beneath a clan's foundations.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Scale first. The figure should be hard to find.

illustrations.title: Two powers over one mountain
illustrations.alt: Two distant figures above a burning mountain.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. Both must read as out of the player's league. The viewpoint is at the edge, not between them.

illustrations.title: Spring, then autumn
illustrations.alt: A glacier under a red sky, time out of joint.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. The one rewind. Fixed outcome; render it as a cost, not a power.

illustrations.title: Yin, and what it changes
illustrations.alt: Two figures on ice, one newly two-armed.
illustrations.prompt: Stylised low-poly wuxia, hand-painted texture-atlas feel, soft cel lighting. The arm is back and something else is different. Neither of them is discussing it.

characterSheets.note: One model sheet per named character, built from the appearance notes in canon/characters.json with their chapter references. Rigs must expose the shared animation set in engine/render/actors.ts.
characterSheets.target: about 30 rigged characters at 3-5k triangles with LODs
characterSheets.status: procedural stand-ins ship today; the actor API swaps a glTF rig in without touching scene data
